title: Smith, Lyle & Moore Hunt #2: Glimmer

prize.note: 3,177,700 sats, funded in a single transaction on 2022-07-29, unspent

target_format: BIP39 12 words, English wordlist, plus a passphrase, BIP84 m/84'/0'/0'/0/0, P2WPKH

derivation.summary: 12 BIP39 words plus a passphrase, scattered across 3 password-gated web pages, derived along BIP84 to a P2WPKH address matching the escrow; the author separately published the account xpub
derivation.certified_against: the published account xpub, whose m/0/0 P2WPKH address equals the escrow, and a known-wrong BIP39 test vector confirmed to produce NO MATCH. tools/oracle_pure.py additionally certifies the BIP39-mnemonic-to-seed leg against the official BIP39 test vector and the whole pipeline against the official BIP84 vector address at m/84'/0'/0'/0/0, and agrees byte for byte with bip_utils on 25 random mnemonics crossed with 5 passphrases

difficulty_note: the 12 words and passphrase are locked behind 3 password-gated pages, each requiring a specific author-intended answer to a riddle rather than a decodable cipher; about 5,000 candidates have been tried across the 3 locks with 0 hits, none of them a certified exhaustive negative
